title: Towards Cross-lingual Values Assessment: A Consensus-Pluralism Perspective
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark (X-Value) that evaluates LLMs on dimensions of 'Safety & Ethics' and 'Belief & Expression' (including religion and traditions). It is grounded in Schwartz's Theory of Basic Human Values and explicitly incorporates a 'Consensus-Pluralism' framework to assess how models handle diverse moral and religious viewpoints.
